pages.title: Fruit Trees
pages.text: $(thing)Fruit trees$() grow from a sapling into a tall tree. The $(thing)branches$() are their most important part: they keep growing as long as the climate suits them, putting out $(thing)leaves$() around themselves. The leaves flower and fruit in the right season.$(br2)This mod adds 48 temperate fruit trees; fruit hangs on the leaves during the $(bold)fruiting$() season and is picked directly.

pages.title: Pear Tree
pages.text: Conditions required for growth: $(br)$(bold)$(l:tfc:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)Temperature$(): -14°C - 28°C$(br2)Check the sapling tooltip for its configured wait. Conversion to a branch also needs an active month and suitable climate; branch growth takes additional time. Right-click fruiting leaves to pick; TFC bloom cooldown still applies.$(br2)Northern flowering months: 4, 5; fruiting months: 7, 8. TFC shifts seasons in the south.
A typical Pear tree.
